name: nadlan.gov.il — deals search (single-page app)
accessMethod: HTTPS GET of the page and its public scripts only.
why: The page answers (HTTP 200, CloudFront) and loads Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise (www.google.com/recaptcha/enterprise.js?render=…) — its data calls are CAPTCHA-protected. Reading them automatically would be a CAPTCHA bypass: not done (run 39327144424).
freshness: the official display of the Tax Authority deals — not readable by PROPX
limitations: reCAPTCHA Enterprise in front of the data — never bypassed
a person can verify any deal there by hand (the acceptance fixture lists the keys to look up)

why: A NEWER copy than the register copy PROPX reads (loaded 08.10.2026 vs scraped 19.09.2026; latest deal 28.09.2026 vs 17.09.2026), with real addresses (street + house as GovMap prints them). dates as published run 1900–2048: 15 future-dated rows in the eight cities' last 13 months
amounts truncated to ₪1,000 (508 of the matched deals)
its own sub-parcel numbering: 8,721 of 19,531 matched deals carry another sub-parcel than the register
